\section[(dialogue)]{The body, family, verbs and food — a first pass}

\label{lesson:PA-R73-first-pass-the-body-family-verbs-and-food}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a flower and a leaf.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a hand, a foot, hair, a tooth, the throat
  \item a finger, a lip, the neck, the face, blood
  \item a leg, a knee, a fever, a hospital, ill
  \item pain, medicine, thirst, hunger, happy
  \item sad, a father, a mother, a son, a daughter
  \item a grandfather, a grandmother, a grandfather, a grandmother, a husband
  \item a wife, a child, a boy, a girl, a man
  \item a guest, to drink, to hear, to sit, to sleep
  \item to get up, to walk, to run, to play, to buy
  \item to sell, to give, to put, to open, to cook
  \item to wash, to laugh, to cry, to sing, to dance
  \item to learn, to forget, to want, to bring, to send
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A hand? (\textbf{\pa{ਹੱਥ}}, \emph{hatth}.) A foot? (\textbf{\pa{ਪੈਰ}}, \emph{pair}.) Hair? (\textbf{\pa{ਵਾਲ}}, \emph{vāl}.) A tooth? (\textbf{\pa{ਦੰਦ}}, \emph{dand}.) The throat? (\textbf{\pa{ਗਲਾ}}, \emph{galā}.) A finger? (\textbf{\pa{ਉਂਗਲ}}, \emph{uṅgal}.) A lip? (\textbf{\pa{ਬੁੱਲ੍ਹ}}, \emph{bullh}.) The neck? (\textbf{\pa{ਧੌਣ}}, \emph{dhauṇ}.) The face? (\textbf{\pa{ਚਿਹਰਾ}}, \emph{chihrā}.) Blood? (\textbf{\pa{ਖ਼ੂਨ}}, \emph{khūn}.) A leg? (\textbf{\pa{ਲੱਤ}}, \emph{latt}.) A knee? (\textbf{\pa{ਗੋਡਾ}}, \emph{goḍā}.) A fever? (\textbf{\pa{ਬੁਖ਼ਾਰ}}, \emph{bukhār}.) A hospital? (\textbf{\pa{ਹਸਪਤਾਲ}}, \emph{haspatāl}.) Ill? (\textbf{\pa{ਬੀਮਾਰ}}, \emph{bīmār}.) Pain? (\textbf{\pa{ਦਰਦ}}, \emph{darad}.) Medicine? (\textbf{\pa{ਦਵਾਈ}}, \emph{davāī}.) Thirst? (\textbf{\pa{ਪਿਆਸ}}, \emph{piās}.) Hunger? (\textbf{\pa{ਭੁੱਖ}}, \emph{bhukkh}.) Happy? (\textbf{\pa{ਖ਼ੁਸ਼}}, \emph{khush}.) Sad? (\textbf{\pa{ਉਦਾਸ}}, \emph{udās}.) A father? (\textbf{\pa{ਪਿਤਾ}}, \emph{pitā}.) A mother? (\textbf{\pa{ਮਾਤਾ}}, \emph{mātā}.) A son? (\textbf{\pa{ਪੁੱਤਰ}}, \emph{puttar}.) A daughter? (\textbf{\pa{ਧੀ}}, \emph{dhī}.) A grandfather? (\textbf{\pa{ਦਾਦਾ}}, \emph{dādā}.) A grandmother? (\textbf{\pa{ਦਾਦੀ}}, \emph{dādī}.) A grandfather? (\textbf{\pa{ਨਾਨਾ}}, \emph{nānā}.) A grandmother? (\textbf{\pa{ਨਾਨੀ}}, \emph{nānī}.) A husband? (\textbf{\pa{ਪਤੀ}}, \emph{patī}.) A wife? (\textbf{\pa{ਪਤਨੀ}}, \emph{patnī}.) A child? (\textbf{\pa{ਬੱਚਾ}}, \emph{bachchā}.) A boy? (\textbf{\pa{ਮੁੰਡਾ}}, \emph{muṇḍā}.) A girl? (\textbf{\pa{ਕੁੜੀ}}, \emph{kuṛī}.) A man? (\textbf{\pa{ਆਦਮੀ}}, \emph{ādmī}.) A guest? (\textbf{\pa{ਮਹਿਮਾਨ}}, \emph{mahimān}.) To drink? (\textbf{\pa{ਪੀਣਾ}}, \emph{pīṇā}.) To hear? (\textbf{\pa{ਸੁਣਨਾ}}, \emph{suṇnā}.) To sit? (\textbf{\pa{ਬੈਠਣਾ}}, \emph{baiṭhṇā}.) To sleep? (\textbf{\pa{ਸੌਣਾ}}, \emph{sauṇā}.) To get up? (\textbf{\pa{ਉੱਠਣਾ}}, \emph{uṭṭhṇā}.) To walk? (\textbf{\pa{ਤੁਰਨਾ}}, \emph{turnā}.) To run? (\textbf{\pa{ਦੌੜਨਾ}}, \emph{dauṛnā}.) To play? (\textbf{\pa{ਖੇਡਣਾ}}, \emph{kheḍṇā}.) To buy? (\textbf{\pa{ਖ਼ਰੀਦਣਾ}}, \emph{kharīdṇā}.) To sell? (\textbf{\pa{ਵੇਚਣਾ}}, \emph{vechṇā}.) To give? (\textbf{\pa{ਦੇਣਾ}}, \emph{deṇā}.) To put? (\textbf{\pa{ਰੱਖਣਾ}}, \emph{rakkhṇā}.) To open? (\textbf{\pa{ਖੋਲ੍ਹਣਾ}}, \emph{kholhṇā}.) To cook? (\textbf{\pa{ਪਕਾਉਣਾ}}, \emph{pakāuṇā}.) To wash? (\textbf{\pa{ਧੋਣਾ}}, \emph{dhoṇā}.) To laugh? (\textbf{\pa{ਹੱਸਣਾ}}, \emph{hassṇā}.) To cry? (\textbf{\pa{ਰੋਣਾ}}, \emph{roṇā}.) To sing? (\textbf{\pa{ਗਾਉਣਾ}}, \emph{gāuṇā}.) To dance? (\textbf{\pa{ਨੱਚਣਾ}}, \emph{nachchṇā}.) To learn? (\textbf{\pa{ਸਿੱਖਣਾ}}, \emph{sikkhṇā}.) To forget? (\textbf{\pa{ਭੁੱਲਣਾ}}, \emph{bhullṇā}.) To want? (\textbf{\pa{ਚਾਹੁਣਾ}}, \emph{chāhuṇā}.) To bring? (\textbf{\pa{ਲਿਆਉਣਾ}}, \emph{liāuṇā}.) To send? (\textbf{\pa{ਭੇਜਣਾ}}, \emph{bhejṇā}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Home, school and nature — a second pass}

\label{lesson:PA-R73-second-pass-home-school-and-nature}



\begin{quote}

\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright

  \item a table, a wall, a roof, a cupboard, the floor

  \item a game, a letter, a tree, a flower, a leaf

To count? (\textbf{\pa{ਗਿਣਨਾ}}, \emph{giṇnā}.) To catch? (\textbf{\pa{ਫੜਨਾ}}, \emph{phaṛnā}.) To cut? (\textbf{\pa{ਕੱਟਣਾ}}, \emph{kaṭṭṇā}.) To stop? (\textbf{\pa{ਰੋਕਣਾ}}, \emph{rokṇā}.) To tell? (\textbf{\pa{ਦੱਸਣਾ}}, \emph{dassṇā}.) To lose? (\textbf{\pa{ਗੁਆਉਣਾ}}, \emph{guāuṇā}.) To wear? (\textbf{\pa{ਪਹਿਨਣਾ}}, \emph{pahinṇā}.) To bathe? (\textbf{\pa{ਨਹਾਉਣਾ}}, \emph{nahāuṇā}.) To leave?
